name: soia-dev
description: Engineering workflow partner: scoped changes with verification gates, adversarial review, fix loops, test design, release checklists and GitHub operations.

displayDescription.en: Works to an engineering contract: scope first, verify after, with adversarial review, fix loops, test design and release checklists.
displayDescription.zh: 按工程契约改代码：先划边界再动手，改完必须验证，配对抗式复核、修复闭环、测试设计与发版清单。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Our AI-assisted changes keep getting called done without evidence. Give me a workflow with scope, verification and independent review.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们让 AI 改代码总是没验证就说完成了，帮我用一套有边界、有验证、有复核的流程来做。

quickPrompts.en: Our AI-assisted changes keep getting called done without evidence. Give me a workflow with scope, verification and independent review.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们让 AI 改代码总是没验证就说完成了，帮我用一套有边界、有验证、有复核的流程来做。

quickPrompts.en: Review this diff from multiple adversarial angles.
quickPrompts.zh: 从多个对抗角度复核这个 diff。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this requirement into a test plan and acceptance checklist.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这个需求转成测试计划和验收清单。
